name: Dungeon Journal round 3: lore, user-story polish, previews

context.prompt: Record round 3 of the Dungeon Journal look: Blizzard Encounter Journal lore (tools/build_dungeon_lore.py -> DungeonLore.lua, source wago.tools retail DB2 because Forever has no journal tables), the bosses page description/abilities/needed-for/facts, home card tooltip, the user-story polish list, and the refreshed previews. Note what is unverified in game.

nodes.name: Build boss and dungeon lore
nodes.prompt: Round 3, stream L. Read context/dungeon-journal-contract.md (hard rules + 'Round 3', stream L) and look at context/renders/bosses.png and home.png and the reference /tmp/dj_images/dj3.png. You own ONLY tools/build_dungeon_lore.py, QuestSharing/DungeonLore.lua, QuestSharing/DungeonBossesUI.lua, QuestSharing/DungeonHomeUI.lua and tests/test_dungeon_lore.py, tests/test_dungeon_journal_bosses.py, tests/test_dungeon_journal_home.py. Implement everything in stream L: the generator (cached CSVs in /tmp/ejdata; fetch with curl when missing), the generated DungeonLore.lua with the stub API kept, the bosses page description / abilities / needed-for (nil-guarded ns.dungeonQuests.questsForNpc) / facts with no empty headings, and the home card hover tooltip. Report the coverage (how many of our dungeons and bosses got text). Tests for each item; run your test files plus tests/test_dungeon_quests.py. Report {files, summary, tests, notes}.

nodes.name: Review lore
nodes.prompt: Review round 3 stream L ({{wL.summary}}) against context/dungeon-journal-contract.md 'Round 3' stream L: generator reproducible and offline-safe, DungeonLore.lua small and correct (spot-check 5 bosses against /tmp/ejdata/JournalEncounter.csv, classic versions preferred over reworked ones), text cleaned ($-tokens, colour codes), UI shows no empty headings, needed-for nil-guarded, only client textures, nothing copied from /tmp/dj_addon, no edits outside owned files, tests green (run them). Report {status, issues}.

nodes.name: Fix lore
nodes.prompt: Fix these review issues in round 3 stream L (own only the stream L files): {{vL.issues}}. Report {files, summary}.

nodes.name: Polish the user stories
nodes.prompt: Round 3, stream U. Read context/dungeon-journal-contract.md (hard rules + 'Round 3', stream U) and look at every context/renders/*.png and context/renders/index.html. You own ONLY QuestSharing/DungeonQuests.lua, QuestSharing/JournalItems.lua, QuestSharing/JournalTheme.lua, QuestSharing/DungeonMapUI.lua, QuestSharing/DungeonRouteUI.lua and tests/test_dungeon_journal_quests.py, tests/test_dungeon_quests.py, tests/test_dungeon_route.py, tests/test_dungeon_journal_map.py. Walk the six user stories in the contract, fix what gets in the way (small, focused changes), and do the 7 known items, including D.questsForNpc and the header lore line (nil-guarded ns.dungeonLore.dungeon). Never weaken behaviour assertions. Run your test files plus tests/test_ux_b5.py and tests/test_classic_style.py. Report {files, summary (list each user-story fix and why), tests, notes}.

nodes.name: Review user-story polish
nodes.prompt: Review round 3 stream U ({{wU.summary}}) against context/dungeon-journal-contract.md 'Round 3' stream U: walk the six user stories yourself (code + previews) and check each claimed fix really helps; the 7 known items done; D.questsForNpc correct; filters still all reachable; behaviour assertions not weakened (read test diffs); only client textures; nothing copied from /tmp/dj_addon; no edits outside owned files; tests green (run them). Report {status, issues}.

nodes.name: Fix user-story polish
nodes.prompt: Fix these review issues in round 3 stream U (own only the stream U files): {{vU.issues}}. Report {files, summary}.

nodes.name: Integrate and render previews
nodes.prompt: Round 3, stream P (after L and U). Read context/dungeon-journal-contract.md 'Round 3'. (1) Fix seams between L ({{wL.summary}}) and U ({{wU.summary}}) (questsForNpc used by the bosses page, header lore line) with small diffs. (2) Full suite green (loop over tests/test_*.py with /tmp/qs-test-env/bin/python), all QuestSharing/*.lua compile under Lua 5.1 (lupa.lua51). (3) tools/render_journal.py (you own it and context/renders/*): clip scroll children, render home with search text so the clear button shows, render the bosses page with a real description, abilities and needed-for, re-render all scenes, update context/renders/index.html. Add one CHANGELOG Unreleased line for round 3 and a README sentence about boss descriptions. Report {files, summary, tests, notes}.

nodes.name: Review round 3 result
nodes.prompt: Final review of round 3 ({{prev.summary}}): look at context/renders/*.png and index.html next to the references; walk the six user stories in context/dungeon-journal-contract.md 'Round 3' on the previews; check the lore text is clean and correct for the Deadmines bosses; full suite green (run it); no copied code/media from /tmp/dj_addon in QuestSharing/; client textures only. Report {status, issues}.

nodes.name: Fix round 3 issues
nodes.prompt: Fix these final review issues of round 3 (keep the full suite green, re-render the previews if the look changed): {{vF.issues}}. Report {files, summary}.
